The Brief Inference operator maps linguistic and visual cues into a probabilistic intent vector. Design Variance Dial quantifies how much deviation from standard templates is acceptable, using page kind and vibe words as inputs. Anti-Default Discipline acts as a constraint enforcement mechanism, ensuring that design outputs avoid known LLM default patterns. The failure mode occurs when brief ambiguity leads to incorrect inference, which is mitigated by a single clarifying query. The system operates under a dual logic: one of probabilistic inference and another of set-based exclusion.
